fields.display_title: We added new results addressing all concerns. FDVLA-3B shows strong LIBERO performance (94/95/93/76), outperforming Octo/OpenVLA. Three real-world videos demonstrating smooth control and semantic grounding are provided (https://huggingface.co/spaces/fdvla/ano ). RVT-2/ARP were omitted due to incomplete real-robot pipelines, and Pi0-Fast/Pi0.5 remain unstable without full tuning. High-resolution figures will be used in the camera-ready.
